Around [[3660 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''battle''' occurred on and in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. The conflict was initiated by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], who hoped to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], who had made his base in the [[House Palerma's villa|villa]] of the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[House Palerma]] on Serenno's surface. Zallow had been staging strikes throughout the territory of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] throughout the previous [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and so had become the object of Darth Malgus's hatred. Although the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]] succeeded in seizing Serenno from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Master Zallow fled the world, robbing Malgus of his prize. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] initiated an occupation of the world shortly after their arrival, but were not well met by the natives of [[House Teramo]] and [[House Comprassi]]. The two Houses hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to remove the Sith from their world, but all of their hired hands were killed by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] under Malgus's command.
